result.title: Real Cameras are Radiometric
result.summary: We propose the radiometric camera, a model that lifts any central geometric camera model to a radiometric one. The lifted model keeps the projection of the geometric model and adds a finite aperture, a free-form focus surface and a generic vignetting function. We calibrate it by inverse rendering directly on the relative irradiance of the sensor, from the same images of standard calibration targets used in geometric calibration. Geometric calibration absorbs the bias of its feature detections. The proposed radiometric calibration uses no features, and our radiometric cameras have lower reprojection errors on held-out test sets. The focus surface extends defocus modeling from the thin lens to any central camera, and we use it in a first multi-view radiometric reconstruction, which recovers the in-focus reflectance of a texture from defocused images. The vignetting is estimated jointly and accurately reproduces a flat field measured through a diffuser. Because every standard camera model lifts to a radiometric one, the radiometric camera naturally and directly extends generative scene models beyond multi-view geometry to multi-view radiometric ones, where phenomena such as lighting and attenuation can be accurately estimated.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「辐射度相机」模型，将任意中心几何相机模型提升为带有限孔径、自由曲面焦面和通用暗角的辐射度模型，并通过对传感器相对辐照度做逆向渲染完成标定。
AI.relevance_reason: 属相机标定与多视图辐射度重建，虽涉及「从传感器观测反推状态」，但不涉及 VLM 内部表示、latent 推理状态生成或证据筛选决策，缺少可核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
